ns2:section.sectionText: Professional Skills in Information Science-In this course, students will learn about and develop professional skills in the information sciences, a broad and interdisciplinary field at the intersection of people, information, and technology. Students will engage in professional skill building for a broad range of employment in the information professions with a specific focus on internship and career readiness. Always Restricted to Information Sciences majors. At this time, we do not plan on lifting the restrictions on the course. For more information about this major, please visit: http://go.ischool.illinois.edu/BSIS. Questions may be sent to bsis-advising@illinois.edu.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences department.
